description: Compares one guided gym session with its plan: maps the manual laps (the same data get_workout_laps returns) to exercises, sets and rests, and reports planned vs actual with honest deviations. Works for sessions pushed with push_strength_guide (lapGranularity perSet or perExercise, restMode countdown or stopwatch) and push_workout_guide. The plan — exercise order, set counts, rest targets — is read from the lap labels, so `plan` is optional; pass the exercises array you pushed to also check the session against it (missing, extra or reordered exercises, set counts, rest targets). Output: { workoutKey, guide, status ('ok' | 'no-laps' | 'no-guide-labels' | 'unknown-label-format'), format ('strength-perSet' | 'strength-perExercise' | 'workout'), restMode ('countdown' | 'stopwatch' | null), complete (the guide's 'Session complete' lap was reached), reliable, note, checks (get_workout_laps' checks, passed through), lapCount, baselineHr (heart rate of lap 1, the first prep — null for workout guides), cols, exercises: [{ n, name, detail, plan (index into plan or null), planned: { sets, restS }, prep, sets, rests }], afterComplete, unattributed, deviations: [{ code, basis ('labels' | 'plan' | 'heuristic'), ex, plan, laps, detail }] }. prep, sets, rests, afterComplete and unattributed rows are arrays in the column order given by cols. A rest row's peak is the rest lap's max HR and end its min HR (optical HR lags 20–30 s, so the peak lands in the rest, not in the set); endVsBaseline is end minus baselineHr. Deviation codes: unexpected-sequence, rest-split, rest-short, rest-long, short-set, long-set, missing-set, extra-set, rest-target-mismatch, extra-exercise, ended-early, unlabelled-lap, after-complete, order-differs, missing-exercise. reliable is false when checks has an entry other than no-heart-rate (which only nulls the heart-rate fields) or the laps break the guide's step order; the mapping is then best effort and note says why. With restMode countdown a rest lap always lasts exactly its target (the watch advances by itself), so extra rest ends up inside the next set's lap and is not measurable. About 1–4 KB. Read-only.

plan.description: Optional: what the session was meant to be, in order. Pass the exercises array given to push_strength_guide or push_workout_guide as-is — only name, sets and restSec are read. Without it the plan is read from the lap labels alone.

name.description: Exercise name as pushed to the guide, e.g. 'Back Squat'.

restSec.description: Planned rest between sets, in seconds.

workoutKey.description: The 24-character workoutKey returned by list_workouts. Anything else fails with a not-found error without calling Suunto.

name: compare_workout_to_plan
title: Compare workout to plan
